title: Use compatibility consistently across workflows
description: Route restored drafts, profile selection, preview, and PDF preparation through the same compatibility operation and render equivalent outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: All four workflow surfaces invoke the central operation with equivalent normalized inputs
The same request displays the same status, reason codes, confirmations, and recalibration requirement on every surface
Restored drafts are re-evaluated rather than trusting a stale saved display status
No consumer independently infers or broadens compatibility

steps.details: Normalize project, setup, revision, layout, profile, and attestation data into CompatibilityRequest through one shared adapter.
Replace local compatibility decisions in restore, selection, preview, and preparation with the authoritative evaluator and shared presenter.
Recompute results after validated restoration and show stale/missing input reasons rather than reusing persisted presentation state.
Use one fixture across all four paths and assert identical serialized results and accessible reason text.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; route existing consumers through one adapter without redesigning their UI.
Persisted compatibility audit data may be displayed as history but must not replace current evaluation.
The PDF renderer consumes an authorized preparation; it must not decide compatibility.
